scenario: A single-family two-storey slab-on-grade house in Plano, Texas, inspected on a dry August morning. Two deficiencies were written up (grading falls toward the house at the north elevation, and a double-tapped breaker in the main panel); the pool, the well, the septic system and the irrigation system are not present on this lot and are rated accordingly.
notes: Every ourField the published map names has a value here. A rating field takes one of the four values the form's own boxes carry: inspected, not_inspected, not_present, deficient.
This is invented data about an invented property. Nothing here is a record of a real inspection, and no value is a real person, licence number or address.
Read by scripts/verify-statutory-render.mjs. Correct a value in place; nothing generates this file.

values.additional_information_provided_by_inspe: The house was occupied and furnished at the time of the inspection. Stored belongings limited access to portions of the garage wall, the rear bedroom closet and roughly a third of the attic floor. Utilities were all on. This report covers the main dwelling only.
values.structural_foundations_comments: The slab was walked and sighted from all four elevations. Elevation differences across the first floor measured within a quarter inch over twenty feet.
values.structural_grading_and_drainage_comments: At the north elevation the soil falls toward the foundation for roughly eighteen feet and stands within an inch of the brick weep holes.
values.structural_roof_covering_materials_comme: Shingles are laid over a single layer with no evidence of a prior covering. Granule loss is even and consistent with the age of the covering.
values.structural_roof_structures_and_attics_vi: From within the attic space at the hallway hatch
values.structural_roof_structures_and_attics_co: Engineered trusses at 24 inches on center. No cut, notched or altered members were observed where access allowed. Decking is 7/16 inch OSB with edge clips.
values.structural_walls_comments: Brick veneer over wood frame at the first floor, fiber cement lap siding at the second. Mortar joints are sound. Sealant at the window head flashing on the west elevation has shrunk and should be renewed as routine maintenance.
values.structural_ceilings_and_floors_comments: Textured gypsum ceilings throughout with no staining, sagging or separation observed in the accessible areas. Engineered wood flooring at the first floor is level and tight.
values.structural_doors_comments: The exterior doors latch, lock and weatherstrip properly. The door between the garage and the house is a rated assembly with a functioning self-closing hinge. Two interior bedroom doors rub at the head jamb and need adjustment.
values.structural_windows_comments: Vinyl double-hung units with insulated glazing. A representative number were opened, closed and latched. The seal at the second unit from the left in the family room has failed and shows persistent fogging between the panes.
values.structural_stairways_comments: Treads and risers are uniform. The handrail is continuous, graspable and returns to the wall at both ends.
values.structural_fireplaces_and_chimneys_comme: One masonry firebox in the family room with a metal damper that opens and closes freely. The firebrick and mortar joints are intact.
values.structural_porches_balconies_decks_carpo: The covered rear porch is a monolithic slab with painted steel columns. The columns bear on the slab and are fastened at head and base. No decks or balconies are present at this house.
values.structural_other_comments: No other structural components were present at this property.
values.electrical_service_entrance_and_panels_c: Underground 200 amp service to a main panel in the garage. Two circuits share one breaker lug at position 14, which is a double tap and not permitted by that panel's listing.
values.electrical_branch_circuits_devices_fixtu: A representative number of receptacles, switches and fixtures were operated. Ground fault protection tripped at the kitchen, both bathrooms, the garage and the exterior.
values.electrical_other_comments: No other electrical components were present at this property.
values.hvac_heating_equipment_comments: One furnace in the attic serving the whole house. It responded to the thermostat and produced heat at every supply register tested.
values.hvac_cooling_equipment_comments: Ambient conditions permitted operation. The temperature split across the coil measured eighteen degrees, within the expected range.
values.hvac_duct_systems_chases_vents_comments: Insulated flexible duct in the attic, supported at intervals with no sharp bends or crushed sections observed in the accessible runs. The return plenum is sealed at the platform. Airflow was confirmed at every register.
values.hvac_other_comments: No other heating, ventilation or air conditioning components were present at this property.
values.plumbing_supply_water_meter_location: Parkway box at the northwest corner of the lot
values.plumbing_supply_main_water_supply_valve_: Front flowerbed, in a box beside the hose bibb
values.plumbing_supply_piping_material: Copper at the risers, PEX in the walls
values.plumbing_supply_distribution_fixtures_co: All fixtures were run at once with no appreciable loss of pressure. Both hose bibbs have working vacuum breakers. The hall shower valve drips at the trim.
values.plumbing_drains_wastes_vents_comments: All accessible drains carried water freely and no slow draining was observed. Traps are present and primed at every fixture. Vents terminate above the roof line and are clear.
values.plumbing_water_heating_equipment_comment: One tank type heater in the garage, elevated on a platform, with a temperature and pressure relief valve piped full size to the exterior.
values.plumbing_hydro_massage_therapy_equipment: No hydro-massage therapy equipment is installed at this property.
values.plumbing_gas_meter_location: East side yard, beside the air conditioning condenser
values.plumbing_gas_distribution_piping_materia: Black iron with corrugated stainless connectors
values.plumbing_gas_distribution_and_appliances: The accessible gas piping is supported and free of corrosion. A sediment trap is present at the furnace and at the water heater.
values.plumbing_other_comments: No other plumbing components were present at this property.
values.appliances_dishwashers_comments: The dishwasher was run through a full cycle. It filled, drained and did not leak. The drain line is looped high under the counter and is secured to the cabinet wall.
values.appliances_food_waste_disposers_comments: The disposer runs, grinds and shuts off at the switch. The mounting is tight at the sink flange and the housing is dry.
values.appliances_range_hood_and_exhaust_system: The hood operates on both speeds and the light works. It is a recirculating unit with a charcoal filter rather than a ducted one, which is permitted for this installation.
values.appliances_ranges_cooktops_ovens_comment: All four burners lit and held a flame. The oven reached the set temperature within the expected time. The anti-tip bracket is installed and engaged.
values.appliances_microwave_ovens_comments: The built-in microwave heated a cup of water in the normal time. The turntable, light and fan all operate. The cabinet mounting is secure.
values.appliances_mechanical_exhaust_vents_and_: Both bathroom exhaust fans run and draw. Both are ducted to the exterior rather than into the attic. No bathroom heaters are installed at this house.
values.appliances_garage_door_operators_comment: The opener reverses on contact and the photo eyes are mounted below six inches and reverse the door when interrupted. The manual release is present and moves freely.
values.appliances_dryer_exhaust_systems_comment: The dryer duct is flexible foil rather than rigid or semi-rigid metal, and it is compressed behind the appliance. Replace with smooth wall metal duct and shorten the run.
values.appliances_other_comments: No other appliances were present at this property.
values.optional_landscape_irrigation_systems_co: No landscape irrigation system is installed at this property.
values.optional_swimming_pools_spas_hot_tubs_co: No swimming pool, spa or hot tub is present at this property.
values.optional_outbuildings_comments: One prefabricated storage shed at the rear of the lot, on skids, with no utilities run to it. The roof covering and the door hardware are serviceable.
values.optional_private_water_wells_comments: The property is served by the municipal water supply. No private water well is present.
values.optional_private_sewage_disposal_systems: The property is served by the municipal sewer. No private sewage disposal system is present.
values.optional_other_built_in_appliances_comme: A built-in wine refrigerator in the butler pantry was unplugged and the client asked that it not be energised. It was not inspected.
values.optional_other_comments: No other optional systems were present at this property.
